name: Colombia
eligibility: Not established by the sources verified here. The decision we could read is a constitutional protection action about a specific family, not a scheme setting out who may commission a surrogacy.
paymentModel: Not verified. Nothing in the sources recorded for this page states what may be paid or how payments are regulated, so this page makes no claim about it.
parentage: The 2009 decision concerns custody and mother-child contact for twins born through a surrogacy arrangement. It is not a parentage framework, and it has been described as one far more often than its text supports.

facts.claim: Colombian law contains no express prohibition of surrogacy arrangements.

source.label: Sentencia T-968 de 2009
source.publisher: Corte Constitucional de Colombia (M.P. Maria Victoria Calle Correa)
source.supports: The court's own published decision, dated 18 December 2009. Its holding is that there is no express prohibition and it resolves a tutela about custody and contact; it does not create a regulatory framework and does not make arrangements enforceable.

facts.claim: A commercial legal account states that the regulating decree for surrogacy had not been approved by the Colombian Congress.

source.label: What is surrogate motherhood in Colombia? (law firm blog)
source.supports: A law firm's own blog, and a weak source recorded as such. It is included because it identifies a pending-decree question to check, not because it settles it. Nothing on this page relies on it as an established fact.

openQuestions: The citation repeated across provider websites is wrong. Surrogacy is associated with Sentencia T-968 of 2009; the court's T-968/2014 document concerns disability and incapacity rating. Any page you read that cites T-968/2014 for surrogacy has copied a source that did not check it.
Whether an implementing decree has since been issued was not verifiable with the material we could open.
What a Colombian birth registration or court order means for the child's entry into your own country is entirely outside what these sources address.

This page is marked as insufficient because the only substantive documents we could open are a single tutela and a commercial blog. That is not enough to describe a destination, and it is published to say so rather than to fill a gap.
